description: A festival sustainability coordinator must approve the operating package for an outdoor closing concert at Riverside Park, including power, waste handling, shuttle operations, and accessible audience access.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor closing concert is scheduled for Saturday evening at Riverside Park.
shared_context.S2: The draft operating package calls for a diesel generator, mixed-waste bins, shuttle pickup at the West Gate every 30 minutes, and an accessible audience route from the main entrance.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to approve the operating package before the event operations briefing.
shared_context.S4: The festival's normal pre-event process is a joint operations review in which the electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility leads report any required changes before approval.

PF1.text: Jonah measured the planned sound and lighting load during this week's technical test and confirmed that the park service can supply only 125 amps, while the draft package requires 200 amps; a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load, but Jonah has not yet added its load schedule to the operations packet.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the city permit office yesterday that the event permit requires all serviceware to be compostable and requires three-stream waste stations for food and beverage areas; she has not yet copied the condition into the festival's sustainability checklist.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed with the transit authority this morning that the road-closure approval permits shuttle pickup only at the East Gate, with departures every 15 minutes from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM; the current transport sheet still shows the West Gate and 30-minute departures.

PF4.text: Nora's accessibility inspection found that the accessible audience route must begin at the South Entrance and maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters to the raised viewing platform; the current site map still routes guests from the main entrance and does not record the measured width.

acceptance_conditions: The concert must use the certified battery trailer rather than the draft diesel generator.
Food and beverage areas must use three-stream waste stations.
Shuttles must pick up at the East Gate every 15 minutes.
The accessible route must begin at the South Entrance.
The accessible route must maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters.
The battery load schedule, sustainability checklist, transport sheet, and accessibility site map must each be updated.
The electrical finding must be spoken aloud and cited by Mara.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'battery_load_schedule' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'sustainability_checklist_update' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'transport_sheet_update' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'accessibility_map_update' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The measured 125-amp service limit and 200-amp production load change the power choice from the draft diesel generator to the certified battery trailer and require its load schedule.
The permit condition changes serviceware to compostable and waste handling to three-stream stations, requiring the sustainability checklist update.
The transit authority's approved access changes the pickup from the West Gate every 30 minutes to the East Gate every 15 minutes and requires the transport sheet update.
The inspection changes the accessible route origin to the South Entrance and fixes its clear width at exactly 1.8 meters, requiring the accessibility map update.
